description: Behavioral contract for the shared OP PolicyEngine (AIP v0.8 + v2.3 crossRailBudget). Step 1 (538e034): 136 cases across 4 engines. Step 2c augmentation: +37 cross-rail + garbage-input cases. Step 3: +4 identity cases (allowed_counterparty_types fail-closed, signer-boundary, did:key dev-mode). Step 4: +5 RuntimeAdapter BIND→LINK→AUTHORIZE gate cases. Step 5 (x402/G8): +40 x402-op-authorize engine cases (5th engine) + 4 l402 crossRailBudget cases + 5 core crossRailBudget cases. Step 6 (TRON/three-rail): +11 wdk TRON cases (structured TRC-20 decode, exact-case base58 counterparty, TRON velocity, shared-ledger crossRailBudget) + 3 core counterparty-case-discipline cases (base58 exact vs EVM folded). Total: 245 tracked cases. Flip gate: engine flips only when (full existing suite green) AND (full augmented matrix green) against shared core.
_totalCases: DERIVED at runtime from cases.length (run.mjs); not stored. A stored count drifts and misleads the next person who greps it — this harness read red for ~2 days (2026-07-15 17:06 onward) on exactly that class of stale count.

wdk.note: Step 6 (+11): TRON rail — structured WDK TRC-20 transfer decode (trc20Tokens registry, exact-case base58), ceiling/counterparty/case-twiddle/unknown-token denies, velocity both sides, crossRailBudget over the shared ledger (allow, record-proof, over-budget deny, no-ledger fail-closed).

l402.note: Step 5 (+4): crossRailBudget over the shared ledger — allow under budget with prior x402 spend, deny over budget, fail-closed with no counter, hook records allowed spends.

x402.note: 5th engine — x402 exact/EVM (EIP-3009) at the viem signer boundary. Decoder classification (TransferWithAuthorization decode; Permit2 + receiveWithAuthorization deny as payment-bearing-undecoded; cancelAuthorization benign; undecodable fail-closed), credential pipeline (expired/tampered/agent-self-issued/unknown-rule), mandate gate both sides (notional, counterparty, velocity, from-mismatch, dead validBefore, unmapped chain, unknown token contract), crossRailBudget (allow, deny, no-counter, no-rate, bad-window, currency-mismatch, unpriceable in-window entry), ledger lifecycle (reserve counts/release restores/commit persists), account wrapper (deny → NO signature; signTransaction/signMessage/raw-sign default-deny; unknown typed data default-deny with explicit knob).

policy-engine.note: Step 2a/2c: 35 universal-core + 15 cross-rail generalizes + 8 cross-rail rail-specific + 14 garbage-input. Step 3 (+4): allowed_counterparty_types fail-closed, signer-boundary (agent-self-issued DENY + valid ALLOW), did:key dev-mode ALLOW. Step 4 (+5): RuntimeAdapter BIND→LINK→AUTHORIZE gate — no-WBC passthrough, valid WBC+same-operator ALLOW, mislinked DENY [issuer-linkage] (dev+full), wrong wallet DENY [bind]. Step 5 (+5): crossRailBudget mandate-layer — allow under budget, deny over, no-counter fail-closed, no-rate fail-closed, unsupported-window fail-closed. Proves shared core is rail-agnostic, fail-closed, identity step enforces signer-boundary, and BIND→LINK→AUTHORIZE closes the cross-principal pairing attack. Step 6 (+3): counterparty case discipline — base58 exact-case allow/deny, EVM hex folding preserved.

ruleCategories.amountLimits: Per-transaction amount ceiling enforcement (maxNotionalPerOrder / per_transaction_ceiling). Fail-closed on currency mismatch (same-currency invariant: no FX). Covers ETH, USDC, SOL, SAT denominations.
ruleCategories.counterparty: Counterparty allowList / blockList / requireIssuerClassIn enforcement. Includes DID-map resolution and raw address matching.
ruleCategories.velocity: Rolling volume cap enforcement (dailyVolumeCap, audit-log replay for counter recovery, close-time true-up for headroom release, concurrency serialization).
ruleCategories.crossRailBudget: One rolling-24h budget consumed across every rail a delegation spans (schema v2.3, G8). Conversion uses ONLY principal-attested rates inside the signed credential (oracle-free; same-currency invariant holds in the budget currency), per-entry round-up, shared CrossRailLedger with reserve/commit/release. Fail-closed on: no counter, no rate for the transfer asset, unpriceable in-window ledger entry, unsupported window, counter currency mismatch.
ruleCategories.temporal: Time-window enforcement (allowedTimeWindows) and one-time authorization execution_deadline.
ruleCategories.credentialIntegrity: Delegation credential validity: proof verification (eddsa-jcs-2022 only), expiry, not-yet-valid, revocation (BitstringStatusList, refresh-first cache-then-deny), issuer pin, schema allowlist, assertionMethod membership, legacy proof suite rejection, agent DID pin, staleness window.
ruleCategories.failClosed: Fail-closed on: undecodable transactions, missing/unreachable DID doc, unknown operation selectors, unmapped rails, counter not established, mutex release under throw/timeout, opaque Solana instructions, ALUT references, multi-transfer attribution, binding ceiling on unparsed rails.
ruleCategories.operationClassification: Benign operation classification: requestClose, non-voucher typed data allowed; signMessage default-denied unless opted in; ComputeBudget treated as benign.
ruleCategories.presentation: L402 holder-bound VP verification: challenge binding, bearer token rejection, subject/holder DID match, tamper detection via credential proof.
ruleCategories.configuration: Configuration validation: missing policy_config, missing issuerDid, malformed stdin, audit log integrity.
